```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to analyze the relationship between price and megapixels
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                          size='weight_grams', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, palette='deep')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels of Digital Cameras', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
